manifest.purpose: Governance-only lifecycle policy for Ambitions artifacts. This manifest is subordinate to docs/truth/*, live source, and current proof evidence and may not override them.
manifest.authority_statement: This manifest is governance-only. It is subordinate to docs/truth/*, live source, and current proof evidence and may not override them.

active.notes: Active material is live source or current proof evidence, but it still defers to docs/truth/* and never supersedes them.

supporting.notes: Supporting material can explain current work, but it never controls product, implementation, or release truth.

deprecated.notes: Deprecated material is retained only for continuity and migration context.

archived.notes: Archived material remains traceable, but it is not authoritative and cannot outrank active truth.

historical.notes: Historical material may explain why a direction changed, but it is never a replacement for current truth.

export_safe_view.description: Redacted trace-only view that preserves provenance while removing authority claims.

extraction_evidence.description: Must point to the extracted active replacement and the reason the old artifact was tombstoned.

rollback.description: Must identify the rollback path that restores the prior narrative policy if needed.

tombstoned.notes: Tombstoned material can be retained for traceability only when recovery, finalization, export-safe view, extraction evidence, and rollback are explicit.

export_safe_view.description: A redacted, export-safe view must exist before delete-candidate material can be removed.

extraction_evidence.description: Must show the useful content was extracted before deletion was considered.

rollback.description: Must name the rollback path that preserves the active narrative policy if deletion is reversed.

extract_then_delete_evidence.description: Must prove the file was first extracted into an active or supporting owner before deletion was considered.

delete-candidate.notes: Delete-candidate material requires extract-then-delete evidence and an explicit rollback path.

generated.notes: Generated material is useful for tooling but does not become proof or authority by default.

local-only.notes: Local-only material remains local unless an active owner promotes it into current source or proof.

proof-only.notes: Proof-only material is evidence, not release readiness and not product authority by default.

authority_protection_rules: historical material never overrides active truth
supporting material never overrides active truth
archived material remains traceable but non-authoritative
tombstoned material must describe a recoverable finalization path
delete-candidate material must document extract-then-delete evidence and rollback
generated, local-only, and proof-only material are never authority by default
proof-only material cannot become release readiness without current proof evidence
proof_and_claim_boundaries: local validation is not release proof
local validation is not device proof
local validation is not accessibility proof
local validation is not privacy proof
local validation is not CI proof
local validation is not production proof

steps: Remove the manifest, validator, fixtures, and AFEP-026 audit reports.
Keep docs/truth/*, AGENTS.md, README.md, and existing source truth as the active authority path.
Re-run claim scans and git diff --check before closing the batch.

claim_boundaries: This manifest is not release proof.
This manifest is not runtime behavior.
This manifest is not production readiness.
This manifest is not accessibility proof.
This manifest is not privacy/legal approval.
This manifest is not CI proof.
